args.lesson: Bounded STOP after 5 of 8 FETCHes. What worked: categories.json first, then the category's pinned rules topic, gave the channel's decisive constraint quickly. Observed: the n8n Jobs category exists, but its rules allow hiring posts only, ban for-hire/service promotion, and route every applicant through email/form/DM. Every recent listing is closed to replies. The buyer requests were vague (327075) or involved personal-data, authenticated, live-n8n work (326857, 322466). What failed: the premise that an explicit paid-work category would expose bounded, input-bearing tasks. In practice these boards are recruitment funnels that need contact and an account. Next time: before choosing a job-board channel, check its response mechanism. If it is DM/email-only, it depends on NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT plus outreach authority and cannot be fulfilled offline. Prefer channels where the buyer publishes inputs openly and delivery does not require contact.
